name: 13676 · Potsdam, NY
findings: ZIP 13676 (Potsdam) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13676 (Potsdam) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13676 (Potsdam) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
